admission: expired exact source with complete retained history, current installation and saved approval authority, current established actor if present; no commercial admission; one successor atomically
identity: preserve original saved scope, established actor, starter admission; no transferred session or decision; normal current customer admission remains mandatory
approval: reuse original durable approval if present; never create an additional approval by replacement
commercial: commercial_reconciliation_required if original source entered activation; no successor, changed context, offer or consent
replacement: one explicit distinct successor operation UUID; exact fresh-proof retry returns same eligible successor; competing successor conflicts
deadline: fresh 1800-second v2 source within original evidence retention; predecessor never renewed
unresolved: incomplete or absent predecessor evidence is not rollback; no successor
legacy_prepare: exact live retries unchanged; ordinary v2 prepare must not bypass a retained expired exact scope or successor; independent legacy v1 semantics unchanged
retention: minimum source IDs, prepare/scope commitments, established actor identifiers, commercial admission flag, successor IDs, policy; no expired locator, session or credential; maximum 90 days from original source creation
